item.title: Re: Doctors raise safety concerns over Palantir linked AI tool in hospitals
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor The proposed use of artificial intelligence (AI) for writing discharge letters is the culmination of decades of devaluation of the skill of preparing and writing a discharge letter or discharge summary. item.title: Re: Menopausal hormone therapy and long term mortality: nationwide, register based cohort study
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor, Mikkelsen and colleagues analyse systemic menopausal hormone therapy using Cox regression with time-varying exposure and report hazard ratios for mortality. The study contains a number of substantial methodological and statistical limitations that affect the interpretation of the results. item.title: Re: Child and caregiver mental health in conflict affected settings
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor The BMJ editorial offers a clear account of the scale of child mental health need in conflict-affected settings and the importance of integrating caregiver support within sustainable systems.
